subject: Request: Custom bundle discount for AWS marketplace listing
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Park <sara.park@acmecl.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Custom bundle discount for AWS marketplace listing

Team — looping you in on a time-sensitive ask from Acme. They want a custom bundle published to AWS Marketplace (co-sell) and are asking for an introductory discount to hit procurement thresholds.

Why this matters:
- Potential ACV: $1.1M ARR in year 1 (see attached grid).
- Strategic: AWS co-sell lead and potential reference customer for logistics vertical.
- Timeline: Procurement needs pricing sign-off by COB Weds (48 hours).

What Acme is asking for:
- 25% off list for the first 12 months on our standard marketplace SKU bundle (compute + support).
- Commitment to a 3-year procurement SOW if initial pilots meet KPIs.

Attachments: acme_pricing_grid.xlsx (pricing + volumes), draft_sow.pdf (pilot SOW).

Ask for internal team: Can Deal Desk/Finance evaluate an exception for a one-time 25% introductory discount and confirm whether we can publish a custom SKU on AWS Market? If we can’t get 25% approved, what’s the max discount we can commit to today that still keeps margin >= 32%?

I flagged this to Ben + Aditya — Aditya, can you run an initial margin calc and let Acme know the ballpark? Ben/Laura — would appreciate quick guidance on escalation.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Custom bundle discount for AWS marketplace listing

Logan — thanks for the context and attachments. Quick notes:

- I ran a preliminary unit-cost calc against the volumes in the spreadsheet. 25% would push effective margin below our 32% floor unless we secure an AWS co-sell offset and a 6-month upfront payment.
- Can you confirm the expected shipment cadence (pilot Q4) and whether Acme is open to a MWBE/enterprise procurement clause (affects payment timing)?

Next steps (internal):
1) Ben: can Deal Desk provisionally approve an exception range (e.g., 18–22%) pending manager sign-off?
2) Laura: can we get a fast-track manager approval if we attach the AWS co-sell commitment as a condition?
3) Logan: please ask Acme to sign the SOW addendum with a 6-month partial upfront to protect margin — I’ll attach a sample clause.

If manager signs off, I’ll take the exception to Finance for final margin sign-off.

— Aditya
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
From: Sara Park <sara.park@acmecl.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: David Chang <david.chang@aws-partner.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 12:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Custom bundle discount for AWS marketplace listing

Logan/Aditya — appreciate the quick response. A few clarifications from Acme:

- We can commit to a 12-month pilot with a signed SOW; the procurement team prefers a 6-month payment milestone (50% upfront, 50% on completion).
- AWS has indicated they will prioritize co-sell if the marketplace listing goes live before our RFP window closes on 09/10.
- Time is the constraint — procurement will push us out of the RFP if pricing isn’t nailed down by 09/01.

We are comfortable with a conditional approval tied to AWS co-sell confirmation. If you can provide a firm published offer and a DocuSign-ready SOW by EOD tomorrow, we can lock the 3-year path.

Regards,
Sara Park
Head of Strategic Sourcing
Acme Cloud Logistics
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Custom bundle discount for AWS marketplace listing

Ben/Aditya — after reviewing the economics and strategic upside I approve an exception with constraints. Approved parameters: 22% max discount off list for the first 12 months, provided all of the following are true:

- Condition 1: Acme signs the SOW addendum with 50% payment upfront (6-month milestone).
- Condition 2: We receive written AWS co-sell commitment (email from AWS rep) within 72 hours of listing publish.
- Condition 3: We publish a custom SKU on AWS Marketplace that includes a 12-month promotional price and a standard renewal at list thereafter.

If Deal Desk confirms the 22% yields >=32% margin net of AWS fees with the upfront payment, consider this approved. Ben — please handle the marketplace listing flow and provide the DocuSign link back to Logan.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sara Park <sara.park@acmecl.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, David Chang <david.chang@aws-partner.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Custom bundle discount for AWS marketplace listing

All — Deal Desk confirms approval based on Laura's conditions. Summary of final decision and next steps:

Decision:
- Approved discount: 20% off list for the first 12 months (we are authorizing 20% to balance win probability and margin protection).
- Publish: custom SKU on AWS Marketplace with promotional price (12 months).

Conditions (must be met prior to listing):
1) 50% upfront payment per SOW addendum (attachment: draft_sow.pdf).
2) Acme to obtain and forward written AWS co-sell email commitment (David, please confirm).
3) HubSpot deal updated with final pricing and signed SOW (HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/deal/DEAL-2027-4411).

DocuSign & attachments:
- I’ll generate the DocuSign packet and share by EOD (DocuSign draft link: https://www.docusign.com/console/documents/abcdef123456).
- Attached: acme_pricing_grid.xlsx, draft_sow.pdf (for internal review).

Sara — Logan will send the SOW addendum and DocuSign once David confirms AWS co-sell. If all checks out, we can publish the listing tomorrow and trigger the co-sell motion.

— Ben Carter
Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
